title: Analytics Engineer
description:
TIRED OF BEING TOLD “THAT’S NOT YOUR SCOPE”?

Plenty of good analysts hit the same wall: you query the data but never build the pipelines, you’re boxed into one lane, and more scope means waiting your turn. Here, it’s the opposite.

Taptap Send moves billions of dollars a month across 6 of 7 continents. We’re probably the largest, fastest-growing money movement business you’ve never heard of. Cards, wallets, business-to-business payments, institutional payments, and new markets are all launching now, and each needs its data, reconciliations and reporting built from scratch. That’s your work.

THE JOB

You’ll own the external reports the business can’t operate without, then automate them into reliable, reusable dbt models. From day one you’ll work with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product and Data Engineering to make sure every number is modelled correctly.

- Own external reporting: deliver the datasets behind month-end close and regulatory reporting, on time, every cycle.

- Automate: turn multi-day manual work into scheduled pipelines, runbooks and dbt models, so it only gets done once.

- Get ahead of launches: build reports and reconciliations as each product and market goes live, before anyone asks.

- Be first line for data requests: build models so people and AI agents can answer repeat questions themselves.

- Keep data trustworthy: build tests, checks and alerts that catch reconciliation breaks and stale data before they become incidents.

- Share what you know: peer-review code and join our weekly meetups.

WHY YOU’LL WANT IT

Grow as fast as you’re able. We hire for potential, not years of experience. On a lean, talent-dense team, you’ll own real work early and take on more the moment you’re ready.

Go from querying data to designing systems. Data, product or business analyst? You don’t need to be an analytics engineer yet. Build the pipelines behind the numbers, and learn dbt, testing, automation and AI tooling from senior analytics engineers.

Don't get boxed in. Own the reporting, automate it, then take on our biggest problems wherever they sit. Your hiring manager started in Finance and has since worked across Partner Ops, Fraud, Compliance, Reconciliation and Product.

See the whole business. You’ll follow a transfer from the moment a customer taps send, through partner payout and reconciliation, to the report a regulator reads.

Own numbers that matter. Auditors and Finance rely on what you build. This isn’t a dashboard role.

Put more money in families’ hands. Remittances are a lifeline for millions of families and are worth more than all foreign aid. Every report you automate helps us keep transfers cheap and reliable.

YOU’LL FIT IF YOU HAVE

- 1-2+ years in a data or analytics role

- A technical or quantitative degree, or equivalent experience

- Strong SQL and experience wrangling messy, complex data

- Some experience automating repetitive work (e.g. scripts, scheduled jobs)

- A strong sense of ownership: when something is broken, ownerless or late, you step in, fix it, and make sure it doesn’t happen again

- Reliability under deadlines, a “no task too small” attitude, and comfort chasing stakeholders

- The right to work in the UK

Nice to have: startup or scale-up experience, Python or R, dbt, Looker or Mode, and something you’ve built, at work or on the side, because the manual way annoyed you.

Sound like you? Apply, even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to meet you.

title: Applied Scientist, Ranking & Recommendations
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Every courier who works with Relay chooses their day. A day is a set of routes that have to fit together, and every courier's ideal day competes with everyone else's. Work is finite and every route still has to be covered, so matching thousands of couriers to the work they want is a recommendation problem with few precedents.

Science at Relay is the brain of the operation: machine learning, operational research, recommender systems, causal inference, location intelligence and experimentation, working together to decide how every parcel gets delivered. There's no existing recommender to iterate on. You'll build it.

RECOMMENDER SYSTEMS HIGHLIGHTS

- Combinatorial, constrained and competitive: every recommendation has to be feasible for the whole network, not just right for one courier.

- Your models power large-scale optimisation that balances thousands of couriers' preferences against the constraints of a physical network.

- Price is part of the recommendation, so economics, personalisation and optimisation have to work as one.

- Our apps collect millions of data points every day.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As an Applied Scientist at Relay, you'll:

- Set the standard for recommender systems at Relay.

- Lead the evolution of Relay's recommender from research to production.

- Design and build the recommender systems that power Relay's key decisions.

- Partner with Operational Research to unite recommender models and optimisation.

- Contribute to Relay's research culture, and develop our voice in the tech community.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO…

- Have built recommender systems at scale, owned them in production, and led their direction.

- Bring deep expertise in recommender systems, reinforcement learning and LLMs, whether from a PhD, publications, or years at the frontier in industry.

- Think in experiments, and let evidence guide decisions.

- Are energised by open-ended problems, and know how to make them tractable.

- Collaborate generously, and explain complex ideas simply.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

- Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

- 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

- All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

- People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

title: Clinical Documentation Quality Reviewer
description:
At Memorial Hermann, we pursue a common goal of delivering high quality, efficient care while creating exceptional experiences for every member of our community. When we say every member of our community, that includes our employees. We know that when our employees feel cared for, heard and valued, they are inspired to create moments that exceed expectations, while prioritizing safety, compassion, personalization and efficiency. If you want to advance your career and contribute to our vision of creating healthier communities, now and for generations to come, we want you to be a part of our team.
Job Summary
The Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDI) Quality Reviewer responsibilities include comprehensive secondary clinical chart reviews to identify potential missed opportunities for documentation clarification, act as a liaison between coding and CDI to resolve Diagnosis-Related Group (DRG) or other code discrepancies, collaborate with CDI educator to educate CDI team based on opportunities identified in second level reviews and work directly with clinicians and providers to improve the overall quality and completeness of documentation through the query process and/or provider education. The CDI Quality Reviewer will collaborate closely with Coders, Coding Quality Auditors, Quality Department and Providers to assure documentation is clinically appropriate, accurately reflects the severity of illness and risk of mortality for the patient and is reflective of current CMS or other regulatory standards. Typically reports to the CDI Quality/Education Manager. Job Description
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
Education: Bachelor's of Nursing, required; Master’s Degree in Nursing or Management preferred.
Licenses/Certifications:

• Current State of Texas license or temporary/compact license to practice professional nursing

• One of the following is required:

• Certified Clinical Documentation Specialist (CCDS) from the Association of Clinical Documentation Improvement Specialists

• Certified Clinical Documentation Integrity Professional (CDIP) from the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA)

• Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) from the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA)

Experience / Knowledge / Skills:

• Three (3) years of Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDI) experience required

• Approved AHIMA ICD-10-CM/PCS Trainer preferred

• Previous CDIS auditing, denial and Vizient experience preferred

• Strong computer proficiency including working knowledge of MS Office- Word, Excel and Outlook and 3M Coding and Reimbursement software; experience with Epic EMR preferred

• Excellent communication, analytical and problem-solving skills are essential

• Strong organizational skills and must be detail oriented

• Highly analytical with strong risk assessment, impact analysis and problem- solving skills

• Highly self-motivated, yet demonstrate ability to be a team player and take direction

• Flexible and able to multi-task and prioritize daily workload, performing concurrent chart reviews as needed

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

• Completes comprehensive, clinical secondary reviews of targeted patient populations to include cases with DRG and/or code discrepancies; mortality reviews to ensure documentation supports risk of mortality; hospital acquired conditions (HACs), patient safety indicators (PSIs) or other top priority diagnoses as identified for potential missed opportunities to clarify documentation or clinically validate a diagnosis.

• Analyzes and interprets clinical data to identify gaps, inconsistencies, and/or opportunities for improvement in the clinical documentation and queries the provider using concurrent query process following ACDIS/AHIMA Guidelines for a Compliant Query Practice.

• Acts as a liaison between the Coding Department and Clinical Documentation Integrity to reconcile discrepancies in code and/or DRG assignment.

• Communicates findings of secondary reviews to Manager.

title: Distributed Systems Engineer - Network Services
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Locations: Austin TX, Champaign IL, Lisbon Portugal, London England, Atlanta GA, Washington DC, 

Location (all hybrid): Austin, TX; Champaign, IL; Seattle, WA; Atlanta, GA; Washington, DC; London, UK; Lisbon, PT

About the team

Cloudflare is redefining the way networks are run at scale, and some of the largest networks in the world now run their traffic through us. Companies connect their data centers, offices, and clouds to Cloudflare, and our network carries, routes, and protects that traffic from hundreds of cities around the world.

Our teams build the systems that make those connections work: the APIs customers use to describe their networks, the control planes that turn that into configuration on every server we run, the health checks that move traffic away from failing paths, and the BGP sessions we run with customer networks (the systems behind products like Magic Transit and Cloudflare WAN). We are a team of engineers and product managers who obsess over quickly building products that solve real customer problems, using techniques that take advantage of Cloudflare's unique architecture and global network footprint.

About the role

We're looking for engineers who like hard distributed systems problems: keeping state consistent across hundreds of data centers, changing configuration safely while traffic is flowing, and deciding what to do when parts of the system fail. You don't need to be a networking expert; we'll help you learn the rest.

Some of the things you'd work on:

• The APIs and control plane services that take a customer's network configuration (tunnels, routes, health checks) and push it to every server in our network, quickly and safely

• Tunnel health checks that run from every data center, and the logic that reroutes customer traffic when a path degrades

• An anycast BGP implementation where customer sessions survive being moved between servers and data centers, built partly on Cloudflare's own developer platform

• Experimental tooling that catch routing flaps and failures before customers do

• Getting logs and analytics back to customers so they can see what their networks are doing
